quantum.title: Entanglement Geometry Beyond Polygons: Graph-Theoretic Entanglement Inequalities
quantum.summary: arXiv:2611.25019v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement entropies of pure multipartite states can be constrained by organizing subsystem cuts as edges (hyperedges) of graphs (hypergraphs). Starting from the one-party entanglement polygon inequality, we derive these constraints from strong subadditivity and pure-state complementarity, with optimal coefficients and explicit equality conditions.
